LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 9.1.1 PRONUNCIATION : CONSONANT AND VOWEL SOUNDS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1: Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Pronunciation : Consonant and Vowel Sounds
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Pronunciation : Consonant and Vowel Sounds, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should you pronounce words correctly? 2. How can one improve one's pronunciation ?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Pronunciation : Consonant and Vowel Sounds together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: A learner listens to audio clips and watch videos on pronunciation

● Learning to learn: A learner builds on their own experiences by reflecting on the target consonant and vowel

sounds and identify those they struggle with for further practise.

Values:
● Patriotism is enhanced through poems on nationalism

● Unity is enhanced in the songs on nationalism

Link to other subjects:

● All language subjects focus on pronunciation as a basic skill.

● Performing Arts emphasises clear enunciation in performances.

Suggested Learning Resources

Audio-visual clips, audio recording, sample poems.
